retry() {
    local cmd=$1
    local max_retries=5
    local delay=1
    local attempt=1

    while [ $attempt -le $max_retries ]; do
        echo "Attempt $attempt of $max_retries: $cmd"
        if $cmd; then
            echo "Command succeeded."
            return 0
        fi
        sleep $delay
        delay=$((delay * 2))
        attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    done

    echo "Command failed after $max_retries attempts."
    return 1
